standard: OWASP Top 10 + OWASP ASVS + CWE — static (SAST-lite) source review
note: Deterministic static security review of a source repository. Every check is decided in code (evaluate.mjs) from grep/dependency/container signals. Heuristic pattern matches are signals for review, not proof of exploitability; high-confidence categories fail, lower-confidence ones warn. decision_mode is 'auto' for all checks.

checks.title: No committed secrets or credentials
checks.obligation: Secret material (keys, tokens, real .env) must never be committed.

checks.title: Strong password/data hashing (no md5/sha1)
checks.obligation: Use modern, salted hashing for credentials; never md5/sha1.
checks.pass_criteria: bcrypt/scrypt/argon2/pbkdf2 present; no md5/sha1 for sensitive data.

checks.title: No insecure randomness for security values
checks.obligation: Tokens/secrets/OTPs must use a CSPRNG, not Math.random/random.random.
checks.pass_criteria: No weak RNG tied to security values.

checks.title: No SQL built by string concatenation
checks.obligation: Use parameterized queries; never interpolate input into SQL.

checks.title: No OS command built from interpolated input
checks.obligation: Avoid shell execution with user input; use argument arrays / no shell.

checks.title: No dynamic code evaluation (eval/Function/exec)
checks.obligation: Dynamic code execution is a code-injection risk and should be reviewed/removed.

checks.title: No insecure deserialization
checks.obligation: Never deserialize untrusted data with unsafe loaders.

checks.title: No dangerous HTML/DOM sinks with dynamic data
No permissive CORS in code
checks.obligation: Do not allow all origins (especially with credentials).

checks.title: Debug mode not enabled in committed config
checks.obligation: Debug/verbose error modes must be off for production.
checks.pass_criteria: No DEBUG=True / app.debug=True / debug:true in committed config.

checks.title: No sensitive data written to logs
Dependency lockfile committed
checks.obligation: Commit a lockfile to enable reproducible, auditable dependency versions.
checks.pass_criteria: A lockfile is committed alongside the manifest.

checks.title: Container does not run as root
checks.obligation: Containers should drop root via a USER directive.
checks.pass_criteria: Every Dockerfile sets a non-root USER.

checks.title: Container base image is pinned
checks.obligation: Pin base images to a tag/digest, not :latest.
checks.pass_criteria: FROM images carry a specific tag or digest.
